HPCL-MS-0010.title: MOTOR SPIRIT
HPCL-MS-0010.subTitle: Motor Fuel
HPCL-MS-0010.description: Motor Spirit (MS) (IS 2796) is a light petroleum distillate used in spark-ignition internal combustion engines. It is produced through atmospheric distillation, catalytic reforming, isomerization and blending of various refinery streams. In India, MS conforms to applicable fuel quality standards.
HPCL-MS-0010.appData: Primarily used as an automotive fuel for passenger vehicles including cars, motorcycles and scooters. Also used in small generators, agricultural light machinery and recreational vehicles.

HPCL-MS-0008.subTitle: MOTOR FUEL

HPCL-MS-0008.appData: Primarily used in transportation (Cars, Sport Utility Vehicles, Motorcycles and Scooters).

HPCL-MS-0009.title: POWER100
HPCL-MS-0009.subTitle: SPECIAL MOTOR FUEL
HPCL-MS-0009.description: Power100 is premium branded Motor Spirit with Research Octane Number (RON) 100 and no Ethanol. It is produced by addition of special high quality additives which enhance the overall performance of Motor Spirit and deliver superior engine efficiency and responsiveness.
HPCL-MS-0009.appData: Recommended for luxury and high-end cars requiring very high octane fuel for improved engine performance, acceleration and combustion efficiency.

HPCL-MS-0002.title: HSD (High Speed Diesel)
HPCL-MS-0002.subTitle: MOTOR FUEL
HPCL-MS-0002.description: High-Speed Diesel (HSD), also known as Automotive Diesel Fuel, is produced from the fractional distillation of crude oil between 200°C and 400°C resulting in a mixture of carbon chains and is composed of saturated hydrocarbons and aromatic hydrocarbons.

specifications.property: Carbon residue (Ramsbottom or micro) on 10 % residue
Oxidation stability (for diesel fuel having FAME content of above 2 percent v/v)
Oxidation stability (for diesel fuel having FAME content of above 2 percent v/v)

specifications.value: wear scar diameter (wsd) at 60 ºC, μm, Max 460

HPCL-MS-0002.appData: HSD is commonly used as a fuel in medium and high-speed compression ignition engine in commercial vehicle, stationery diesel engines, locomotive and pumps etc. It is also used as fuel in power generation (DG sets), agriculture and construction machinery.

HPCL-MS-0006.title: HP Turbojet
HPCL-MS-0006.subTitle: MOTOR FUEL
HPCL-MS-0006.description: HP Turbojet is premium branded fuel produced by addition of special high quality additives which enhances overall performance of High Speed Diesel.
HPCL-MS-0006.appData: Used as a fuel in medium and high-speed compression ignition engines in high-end vehicles.

HPCL-MS-0007.title: ETHANOL BLENDED MOTOR SPIRIT
HPCL-MS-0007.subTitle: MOTOR FUEL
HPCL-MS-0007.description: Motor Spirit (also known as Motor Gasoline) is a distillate fraction, normally boiling within the range 30°C to 210°C. It is a complex mixture composed of relatively volatile hydrocarbons (alkanes, alkenes and aromatics with typical carbon chain length of C5 to C10) that vary widely in their physical and chemical properties.

specifications.property: Water Tolerance of Motor Gasoline–Alcohol Blends

specifications.value: Max 15 % v/v (MTBE, ETBE, TAME) / Other oxygenates not permitted
100 − Ethanol content and stabilizing additives (% v/v)

HPCL-MS-0007.appData: Primarily used in transportation (Cars, Sport Utility Vehicles, Motorcycles and Scooters). E20 Fuel was launched in India on 6th Feb 2023. As on date regular MS is substituted by E20 MS. It is observed that E20 fuel is being used in existing spark-ignition engine. E20 fuel has several advantages over conventional MS, such as it reduces vehicular tailpipe emissions by lowering the carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides levels.
